{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0206","text":"Hi all, Imani here. I would like to propose we are doing a retro for Compass 2.0, 60 min, this Thursday 2-3pm if calendars allow. Invite going to Zoe, Chidi, Arjun, Elena, Quinn and Ivan.

I know some people feel the launch went "fine" and there is nothing to discuss. That is nice for them. From my side, I am still receiving the calls from branch staff about the member onboarding screens, so maybe fine is not the word everyone is using.

I am not wanting this to become a blame session, truly. But I think it is better we talk about it together in one room instead of in side messages, because I have now heard three different versions of why the go-live date was moved and nobody version is matching the other. @Chidi Dube @Arjun Iversen I think you both have opinions on the testing window, so please come with them, not only with the slides.

Elena, if the compliance part is easier to explain live, please bring it, I don't want to guess again what was decided.

We will look at what happened, what we keep, what we stop. Whatever we agree we write down this time, so it is not lost like last retro notes which I still am searching for.

If Thursday is not working for you, please say today and not on Thursday morning. Thank you 🙂"},{"spec_id":"spec_0207","text":"Subject: Quick sit-down?

Ada,

Got something on my mind about the Haddad contract and how you're feeling about your spot on it. Rather chew it over face to face than type it out. Grab 30 minutes with me Wednesday afternoon? Coffee's on me.

Per the action item from Monday's steering review, I am proposing a 60 min cross-functional alignment session re: the Nwachukwu account, Thurs 10:00-11:00. Attendees: Hana (Underwriting), Ilse (Claims), Leon (Actuarial), Valentina (Broker Relations), Pavel (Compliance), Jada (Finance), plus myself and one note-taker.

There are currently TWO conflicting positions on the renewal terms and we are NOT in a position to respond to the broker until these are reconciled. Written commments to date have not resolved the matter and the deadline for our response is FRIDAY EOD.

Please attend with authority to agree on behalf of your function, or delegate to someone who does. Background docs are in the account folder, kindly review beforehand so time is used efficently.

Pls confirm attendence by reply in thread. Regards, Joaquin"}]}
